Former simulation blocker resolved for the explicitly bound reference (2026-10-08): Unvalidated reference footprint and signal map; HDMI protocol is not simulable. Resolution: Resolvable as an explicit alternate binding (same treatment as OHM-044's explicit alternative), not as the default CT_19APL2 footprint. The archived Same Sky HD12-19-SMT-TR sheet gives rated voltage 40 Vac max, rated current 0.5 A max, contact resistance 20 mOhm max 'between terminals and mating plug' (measured at 20 mV/100 mA), and on p3 a PIN CONNECTIONS table plus a Recommended PCB Layout marked NO.1 ... NO.19. That is a true contact-path specification with the part's own numbering. HDMI TMDS/DDC/CEC/HPD protocol stays out of scope.
